nit.issue: '{amount} होल्ड' transliterates 'hold' where 'रोका गया' is the natural money-state phrase; the loanword is widely read in Indian fintech copy and the chip has a cell budget.
'{amount} शुल्क' names the fee rather than the act; '{amount} शुल्क लिया' would parallel the held chip.

notes: Severity counts are the RESIDUAL findings on the corrected bytes. Strings this audit rejected were corrected in the same commit and are listed under corrections; they are not counted as unresolved.
